title: Geospatial OSINT, Multimodal Vision & Zero-Network Hybrid Search Engine
whyParagraphs: Property Intelligence was built to automate technical real-estate audits, neighborhood context scoring, and interior furnishing recommendations across Spanish residential listings. Standard LLM wrappers fail immediately in this domain: vision models misread wide-angle distortion, unstructured prompts mutate factual portal numbers, missing government raster data (NoData) gets hallucinated as safe, and hosted vector APIs add latency and cost during multi-item interior optimization.
The architecture replaces free-form agent loops with an 18-stage deterministic Python pipeline wrapped around strict epistemic contracts and zero-network local search.

subsystems.title: 18-Stage Deterministic DAG Orchestrator (S01-S18)
subsystems.summary: Wraps every acquisition, vision, geospatial, and synthesis task in typed contracts with item-level checkpointing and automated schema repair.
bullets: Every step inherits from StageContract (SingleActionStage or ItemSequenceStage), logging structured execution spans through StageLogger and persisting granular state inside CheckpointManager and job_ledger.

When an upstream LLM or acquisition adapter drops a field or hits rate limits, provider_recovery and contract_repairs isolate the failure, repair schema violations deterministically, and resume from the exact failed item without rerunning expensive vision calls.

subsystems.title: 6-Tier Epistemic Hierarchy & Anti-Hallucination Gate
subsystems.summary: Separates immutable observed facts from probabilistic model assessments and rejects mutated claims fail-closed.
bullets: Every claim emitted by the pipeline carries an explicit epistemic_class (CANONICAL_FACT -> DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION -> MODEL_OBSERVATION -> MODEL_ASSESSMENT -> RISK_HYPOTHESIS -> RECOMMENDED_ACTION), a status (OBSERVED | UNKNOWN | UNAVAILABLE), and a SHA-256 provenance reference.

During synthesis, model_metadata.web_access is locked to false. A deterministic SemanticConservationValidator rejects any output that mutates observed inputs, converts missing raster values (e.g., flood GRAY_INDEX: 999) into negative safety claims, or invents unbacked percentage lifts.

subsystems.title: Zero-Network Local Hybrid Search & Beam Search Optimizer
subsystems.summary: Fuses local Tantivy BM25 and pinned ONNX Runtime E5 embeddings offline via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60).
bullets: To match room gaps against an interior product catalogue without hosted vector databases or external embedding calls, hybrid_catalogue_index.py runs two local lanes side by side: Tantivy 0.26.2 (Rust BM25) and ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 executing intfloat/multilingual-e5-small (384-d embeddings via attention-mask mean pooling and L2 normalization).

Before loading weights, the runtime resolves Hugging Face's content-addressed cache and checks exact SHA-256 digests for model.onnx, tokenizer.json, and config files. Both top-100 candidate sets merge via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) with deterministic tie-breaking, feeding a Beam Search optimizer that scores spatial fit, clearance, and palette continuity across multi-item ensembles.

subsystems.title: Geospatial OSINT, Computer Vision & Decoupled React 19 UI
subsystems.summary: Joins DuckDB Spatial over Overture Maps, official Spanish registries, Manhattan-world camera math, and pure view-model rendering.
bullets: Spatial ingestion combines DuckDB (httpfs + spatial) queries over Overture Maps, Shapely 2.0 geometry, cost-gated Google Places/POI calls, and official Spanish data sources (Catastro, INE ADRH census statistics, IGN/MITECO environmental layers).

Visual processing runs persistent Playwright CDP harvesting, Manhattan-world wide-angle camera auto-calibration, a 2D spatial clearance linter, and layered SVG floorplan composition. A standalone React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind v4 frontend consumes only pre-validated view-model JSON via sync-listing-data.mjs.

stages.name: Persistent CDP & Snapshot Acquisition
stages.happyDetail: Captures raw portal HTML and downloads binary images with SHA-256 digests.
stages.driftDetail: Immutable SHA-256 snapshot remains preserved on disk; zero re-scraping needed.

stages.name: Pixel Observation & Camera Calibration
stages.happyDetail: Extracts room types, spatial fixtures, and Manhattan-world lens calibration.
stages.driftDetail: Checkpointed item sequence artifacts remain cached inside CheckpointManager.

stages.name: DuckDB Spatial, Overture & Catastro OSINT
stages.happyDetail: Executes DuckDB httpfs/spatial joins and preserves flood NoData as UNKNOWN.
stages.driftDetail: Canonical context pack locked; downstream layers cannot alter INE or IGN facts.

stages.name: Local Tantivy + ONNX Hybrid Retrieval
stages.happyDetail: Runs BM25 + multilingual-e5-small (384-d) with RRF k=60 and Beam Search.
stages.driftDetail: Fail-closed blob verification passes; deterministic ranking preserved.

stages.name: Semantic Conservation Validator & Repair
stages.happyDetail: 0 schema errors: all claims carry evidence_refs, status, and causal_claim: false.
stages.driftDetail: Validator catches dropped Energy G field -> contract_repairs re-synthesizes Stage S16 only -> 0 errors.

stages.name: Decoupled React 19 View-Model Sync
stages.happyDetail: Publishes validated JSON view-model to isolated React 19 + Tailwind v4 surface.
stages.driftDetail: UI stays completely shielded from invalid payloads until S16 passes with 0 errors.
